title: melandrium noctiflorum
intro: Melandrium noctiflorum, commonly known as Night-flowering Catchfly, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Melandrium noctiflorum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
